metadata.title: Conformal Bootstrap for surfaces with boundary in Liouville CFT. Part II: spectral resolution and bootstrap
metadata.abstract: This paper is the second part of the proof of the conformal bootstrap for Liouville conformal field theory on compact surfaces with boundary. It is devoted to the spectral theory of the half-annulus semigroup and to the resulting bootstrap formula. Building on the Segal axioms and gluing properties established in Part~1~\cite{GRW1}, we identify the generator of the half-annulus semigroup with the boundary Hamiltonian and establish its spectral decomposition by scattering methods. This yields a direct-integral decomposition of the boundary state space into irreducible Virasoro representations, governed by the boundary spectral measure. Combining this decomposition with Ward identities for boundary deformations, we express general correlation functions as integrals over spectral parameters attached to cutting curves, with integrands given by products of bulk and boundary structure constants and the corresponding conformal blocks. These results also underpin the analyticity and symmetry properties of conformal blocks~\cite{GRSSbloc}, and contribute to the construction of mapping class group representations on spaces of conformal blocks~\cite{PapierBlocs}.

analysis.progressType: 带边界 Liouville CFT 的 spectral bootstrap
analysis.workSummary: 基于第一部分的 Segal axioms 和切粘，对 half-annulus semigroup 的 boundary Hamiltonian 做 scattering 谱分解，将边界态空间写为不可约 Virasoro 表示的直积分；联合 Ward identities 导出一般相关函数的 bootstrap 积分公式。
analysis.breakthrough: 完成带边界 compact surface 的 Liouville bootstrap 谱理论环节。
analysis.limitations: 结果属于两篇连续工作，依赖第一部分的 axioms 与 gluing；不能将其中一般 CFT 的条件省略。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者说明数学内容一年前已完成，同时披露 AI 用于英文修改和若干次校对；仅计为文字辅助。
